what element comes after hydrogen | what element comes before hydrogen | what is next to hydrogen on the periodic table => Hydrogen is element 1, so nothing comes before it. Helium (2) comes after it. In its column, lithium is below it.
what elements are in the same group as hydrogen | elements similar to hydrogen => Hydrogen sits at the top of group 1, but it isn't an alkali metal. It's a nonmetal gas, so it's often treated as a family of its own.
what element comes after helium | what element comes before helium | what is next to helium on the periodic table => Before helium comes hydrogen (1), and after it comes lithium (3). In its column, neon is below it.
what elements are in the same group as helium | elements similar to helium => Helium is a noble gas. It's in group 18 with neon, argon, krypton, xenon, radon and oganesson. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
what element comes after lithium | what element comes before lithium | what is next to lithium on the periodic table => Before lithium comes helium (2), and after it comes beryllium (4). In its column, hydrogen is above it and sodium is below it.
what elements are in the same group as lithium | elements similar to lithium => Lithium is an alkali metal. It's in group 1 with sodium, potassium, rubidium, caesium and francium. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
what element comes after beryllium | what element comes before beryllium | what is next to beryllium on the periodic table => Before beryllium comes lithium (3), and after it comes boron (5). In its column, magnesium is below it.
what elements are in the same group as beryllium | elements similar to beryllium => Beryllium is an alkaline earth metal. It's in group 2 with magnesium, calcium, strontium, barium and radium. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
what element comes after boron | what element comes before boron | what is next to boron on the periodic table => Before boron comes beryllium (4), and after it comes carbon (6). In its column, aluminium is below it.
what elements are in the same group as boron | elements similar to boron => Boron is in the boron group. It's in group 13 with aluminium, gallium, indium, thallium and nihonium. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
what element comes after carbon | what element comes before carbon | what is next to carbon on the periodic table => Before carbon comes boron (5), and after it comes nitrogen (7). In its column, silicon is below it.
what elements are in the same group as carbon | elements similar to carbon => Carbon is in the carbon group. It's in group 14 with silicon, germanium, tin, lead and flerovium. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.

what elements are in the same group as oxygen | elements similar to oxygen => Oxygen is in the oxygen group, also called the chalcogens. It's in group 16 with sulfur, selenium, tellurium, polonium and livermorium. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
what element comes after fluorine | what element comes before fluorine | what is next to fluorine on the periodic table => Before fluorine comes oxygen (8), and after it comes neon (10). In its column, chlorine is below it.
what elements are in the same group as fluorine | elements similar to fluorine => Fluorine is a halogen. It's in group 17 with chlorine, bromine, iodine, astatine and tennessine. Elements in the same group have similar chemical properties.
